summary: Wave 8A Ecosystem Activation backend testing. Created /app/backend/tests/test_wave8a_ecosystem.py with 17 tests covering search population, discovery entity/related, follow→suggested, growth_items kind classification, GitHub/YouTube/Remotive ingestion, /api/jobs external tolerance, and wave6/wave7 regression (companies favicons, feed/posts, feed/for-you, providers.google, community auth register/login/verify/forgot). All 17 wave8a tests PASS + 16 wave7 + 3 wave6 = 36/36 PASS. Verified: search 'microsoft' total=26 (companies=2, videos=8, repos=8, news=8), 'mongodb' total=25, 'google' total=27 (with jobs), 'kubernetes' total=14 (repos=8, jobs=1). discovery/entity/microsoft/related returns news=8, videos=6, repos=11, jobs=3, similar=8, people=4, hashtags=8. mongodb/related news=8 videos=6 repos=10. Follow microsoft → suggested returns based_on=1 with real related companies (aws, google-cloud, openai, nvidia, github, vercel — NOT fallback). DB counts: growth_items kind=news=1399, kind=video=75, kind=job=31; github_repos=185; jobs remotive=31; sources kind=github_org=13; videos with youtube URL=75. Companies use google favicons (no clearbit). providers.enabled includes google. /api/jobs?limit=5 returns 200 with external Remotive jobs (company_id=None tolerated).

minor.issue: Some items classified as kind='news' in DB are actually YouTube videos from 'Microsoft Developer' channel (e.g. 'What's New in Data API builder | Data Exposed'). They appear both in news bucket and videos bucket. Not a hard-blocker (spec only asked for populated news>=2, which is met), but the kind assignment is inaccurate for those growth_items — RSS handler may be tagging YouTube uploads.xml feeds as news instead of video. Consider treating source URLs matching youtube.com as kind='video' regardless of ingest handler.

Response returns based_on as an integer count, not a list. Spec says 'based_on>=1' which is satisfied, but a client expecting a list of source companies (like the items list) would break. Consider returning based_on as a list of {slug,name} for UI transparency, or document the current int shape explicitly.

action_items: (optional) Re-classify growth_items where source URL is a youtube channel/uploads feed so kind='video' instead of 'news' (currently ~50% of Microsoft/Google/OpenAI 'news' items are YouTube videos).
(optional) Expose /api/discovery/suggested.based_on as a list of source slugs instead of an integer count to help clients render 'because you follow X'.
critical_code_review_comments: sources_center/engine.py: kind assignment on RSS handler should sniff URL/domain — YouTube channel RSS (feeds hosted on youtube.com/feeds/videos.xml) are being tagged as news. Add a post-classify hook: if url matches youtube.com|youtu.be → kind='video'.

discovery/resolver.py: gather() shape mixes list responses (news/videos/repos/similar/people/hashtags = list) and could benefit from a Pydantic response model to lock the contract. based_on inconsistency between int (suggested) and lists elsewhere invites client bugs.
job_routes._job_to_public tolerant of missing company_id — good; but /api/jobs list should also surface external_source so UI can badge Remotive results distinctly.
test_credentials: member.demo@puntocero.test-e2e.com / MemberDemo2026 (already seeded; auto-registered if missing). Ephemeral TEST_wave8a_*@puntocero.test-e2e.com created per run.

The two minor observations (news vs video kind for YouTube-sourced items, and based_on int vs list) are non-blocking and left as optional polish. Regression suites wave6/wave7 continue to pass 100%.
